metric_definitions.fold_strategy_return: equity_curve(last session <= fold_end) / equity_curve(last session <= fold_start) - 1; fold 1 denominator is the curve at the fold-1 start session
metric_definitions.fold_expectancy: sum(period pnl of fills inside fold window) / n_periods
metric_definitions.position_pf: sum(positive period pnl) / |sum(negative period pnl)| over ALL base periods; null when no losses
metric_definitions.fold_mdd: max peak-to-trough drawdown of the equity curve segment inside the fold window
metric_definitions.fold_concentration: factory fold_concentration over the three fold pnl totals, per-arm
metric_definitions.drop_one_etf: value_book rerun with excluded_symbol=select_drop_one_symbol(base symbol_contribution); survival = after-drop expectancy > 0
metric_definitions.drop_one_fold: min over folds of expectancy computed with that fold's periods removed; survival = min > 0
metric_definitions.incremental_alpha: compute_fold_alpha per fold vs build_risk_matched_spy with the arm's frozen rule; overall alpha = sum of fold alphas

volatile_normalization_rule_frozen_befor: when comparing execution-tree artifacts to reproduction-tree artifacts, delete exactly these top-level keys from both sides before byte comparison: ['run_utc']; every other byte must be identical

publication.observed: compute_recorded exactly once per cell BEFORE publication, even if publication then fails
publication.immutability: published artifact bytes are never modified; sha256 recorded in the ledger entry
